name: chart
title: Chart
description: Charts on recharts, as the reference: series colours by role from the data tokens (focal, comparison, rest, mark, alert) as --color-<key>; solid hairline grid, Code-voice ticks, square marks and keys, an inverse tooltip with tabular figures. ChartFigure adds a title and a Chart / Table switch over the same rows. RTL axes and reduced motion are applied for you.
whenToUse: Use it to plot numbers with Recharts in Keyline's construction, with a Table view of the same rows. For one headline figure use Stat; for progress of a task use Progress.

parts.name: ChartContainer
parts.description: The plot area. Sized by CSS (default aspect 16/9; set a height or aspect-ratio with className or style). Name it: `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at a visible title (ChartFigure does this).

props.name: config
props.type: { [x: string]: { label?: ReactNode; color?: string | undefined; unit?: string | undefined; }; }

props.name: format
props.description: Formats values in the tooltip and table. Default: the locale's grouping, at most two decimals.

parts.name: ChartFigure
parts.description: A titled chart with a Chart / Table switch. The table carries the same rows, so every value is readable without the plot (screen readers, forced colours, print, copying figures).
